entries.name: Mathcad MCP server (Prime, COM)
entries.summary: Drive PTC Mathcad Prime via COM — open/calc worksheets, set inputs, read outputs/matrices, units, export (~24 tools). Community fork puran-water/mathcad-mcp, pinned. NOT a packaged project: the repo is a bare FastMCP standalone.py (no pyproject/console-script), so the launch is `python <cloned>/standalone.py` — clone the pinned commit into ${workspaceFolder}/mathcad-mcp and `pip install -r requirements.txt` first (see vendored_source.install_cmd). disabled-until-probe: enables only when Mathcad Prime AND a Python interpreter are present. ALL worksheet-write/calc tools mutate the live Mathcad host application — gate behind operator consent. LICENSE not yet confirmed (no detected LICENSE file at the pinned commit) — license_status pending, confirm before redistribution.

vendored_source.install_cmd: git clone https://github.com/puran-water/mathcad-mcp ${workspaceFolder}/mathcad-mcp && git -C ${workspaceFolder}/mathcad-mcp checkout edd035b42dbbf2c9523e409ee640664d85306e6f && pip install -r ${workspaceFolder}/mathcad-mcp/requirements.txt

entries.name: Excel MCP server (live COM, .NET)
entries.summary: Automate Microsoft Excel through its native COM API — Power Query, DAX measures, PivotTables, charts, formatting, and VBA macros (25 tools / ~230 operations) with real recalc against the live Excel process. Community server sbroenne/mcp-server-excel (C#/.NET 10), pinned to release v1.8.70. Distributed as a self-contained mcp-excel.exe — download from the release ZIP and add to PATH (see vendored_source.install_cmd); the launch command is the bare `mcp-excel` binary, not uvx. disabled-until-probe: enables only when Excel AND the mcp-excel server binary are present. The VBA-exec / RunMacro operations execute arbitrary code in the live workbook — gate the 6 VBA-exec ops behind operator consent (D-4). Windows + Excel desktop only.

vendored_source.install_cmd: download mcp-excel.exe from the v1.8.70 release ZIP (https://github.com/sbroenne/mcp-server-excel/releases/tag/v1.8.70), extract to a tools dir, and add that dir to PATH

entries.name: Ableton Live MCP server
entries.summary: Control Ableton Live over a loopback TCP socket — create/edit tracks, clips, devices, and transport via the Live Object Model. Community server ahujasid/ableton-mcp (Python), pinned, run via uvx from the git source. disabled-until-probe: enables only when Ableton Live is installed. REQUIRES the operator to first install the bundled Ableton Remote Script into Live's MIDI Remote Scripts directory and load it in Live — the MCP server connects to that script over a local loopback socket; the host-exe probe detects Live, NOT the Remote Script, so verify the script is loaded before use.

entries.name: Codex MCP server (OpenAI Codex CLI)
entries.summary: Expose the OpenAI Codex CLI as an MCP server (`codex mcp-server`, stdio) so agents can call codex as a tool (codex() / codex-reply()). Official Codex CLI subcommand — NOT a community fork, so no vendored_source/pin. disabled-until-probe: enables only when the `codex` binary is on PATH. Keep the direct invoke-codex-prompt.sh path for orchestration/commission (file-based, governance); this row is for agents calling codex-as-tool.
